title: Auto Loans: Bank-Error Waiver of Late Charges
content:
Some late charges on Auto Loans accounts arise only because Piedmont Crescent Bank itself mishandled an autopay debit. This page states when such a late charge is withdrawn as PCB's error, the reasoning behind it, and the agent action that records the waiver.

## When the waiver is owed

A late charge stands against the Auto Loans rules if the installment it was charged on went unpaid on account of an autopay debit that PCB sent to one of the borrower's PCB checking accounts already shut on a date earlier than the day the debit posted, the debit then coming back unpaid. The late charge is then waived in full for bank error, by one fee waiver entry naming the late charge. The waiver is due whenever the loan's records disclose these circumstances, whether or not the borrower mentions them.

## Reasoning

PCB answers for where its autopay debits go: an enrollment may draw on no account other than one that is open when the debit is made. An installment that went unpaid because PCB aimed its debit at an account its own records already showed as shut went unpaid through PCB's doing, so the late charge that followed has no footing.

## What the waiver records

The loan's activity gains a fee waiver entry for the named late charge, with bank error as the reason and late charge as the fee code. Unpaid fees on the loan drop by the waived sum less whatever part is applied to principal; unpaid principal drops by that part, which is used only where the late charge had already been paid.

## Calling the action

The agent-side action `waive_late_charge_e8055e73` is kept hidden until the agent unlocks it; once unlocked, the agent calls it.

| Parameter | What it carries | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | reference number of the borrower on the customer profile | identifier |
| `auto_loan_id` | reference number of the loan the late charge sits on | identifier |
| `source_item_id` | reference number of the late charge entry to be waived, as shown among the loan's activity | identifier |
| `amount` | sum waived, the entire late charge | US dollars, two decimals |
| `applied_to_principal` | how much of the waiver goes to principal, which happens only where the late charge was already paid | US dollars, two decimals; 0.00 where it was unpaid |

## Confirmation returned

The call reports status "waived" and gives `waiver_id` for the new entry, `waived_fee_id` for the late charge, the `amount`, and the loan's resulting `fees_due` and `principal_balance`, each to two decimals.
